name: Myczil Savod Zunich
description: Son of Fonn Zunich and Jarad vod Savo whose blood is used to awaken Rakdos; forms a bond of rage with the demon.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
timeline.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.
